description: The scenes of a wiki page — or of every page of a space you may edit — put on other sites (PM-1076): for each, its id, the block ('language' anim or anim-js and its number among that kind's blocks, as get_wiki_page's 'anims' numbers them), the link and the ready <iframe> code, the caption, the sites allowed to frame it (empty is any), the term ('expiresAt', null until removed), who made it and when, and how many times it was opened. Only for somebody who may edit the page; give 'id' for one page or 'spaceKey' for the space.

id.description: Page id. Give this or spaceKey.

spaceKey.description: Space key, for every page of it.

name: list_wiki_embeds
